newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's orders data good but GDP goal still tough.
newsitem.headline: Italy's orders data good but GDP goal still tough.

text.p: Industry Minister Pierluigi Bersani said on Wednesday industrial orders and turnover data released earlier were good, but Italy still had its work cut out to reach the government's economic growth target for this year.
Italian industrial orders rose 14.5 percent year-on-year in April while turnover rose 9.1 percent, national statistics institute Istat said earlier.
Bersani told reporters that the data "confirm the beginnings of a recovery".
"The tendency is towards improvement in data, which we can see now, even if it is not impetuous," he said.

Asked whether that meant that achieving the government's goal of 1.2 percent Gross Domestic Product growth in 1997 would be possible, he said: "In theory yes, but it's not easy. I see it as rather demanding."
Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Monday in Brussels that the target was credible and achievable.
